proposal.rationale: Adds a companion exception qualifying C0001. Section 1910.38(b) provides that an employer with 10 or fewer employees may communicate the plan orally to employees, which acts as an explicit exception to the requirement in C0001 that the emergency action plan must be in writing, kept in the workplace, and available to employees for review.
proposal.quote: However, an employer with 10 or fewer employees may communicate the plan orally to employees.
